title: Our impact
intro: Our 2024–25 impact report shares how Toynbee Hall works with people across East London and beyond to build a fairer future.

blocks.heading: Advice
paragraphs: Our advice services support people with debt and money worries, welfare benefits, legal issues and financial challenges connected to cancer. The report includes client experiences and service outcomes.

blocks.heading: Community
paragraphs: Our community programmes bring children, young people and older residents together through activities, outreach and community-led cultural events.

blocks.heading: Read the report
paragraphs: Explore the 2024–25 Impact Report and previous reports to learn more about our work and its impact.
